Class Either<A,B>

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.collection.Either<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - the type of left
B - the type of right
Direct Known Subclasses:
Left, Right
public abstract class Either<A,B> extends Object
A sum type. Does not allow nulls.
